title: The world's tallest building: who held the record, and for how long
excerpt: From the Great Pyramid to Jeddah Tower: I followed the title of world's tallest building through time. Lincoln Cathedral held it for 238 years, New York for 65, and since 1998 it has been in Asia, where 81 of the 98 buildings of 350 m or more now stand.
seo_description: Every world's tallest building from the pyramids to Jeddah Tower: Lincoln held the record 238 years, New York 65. Maps and data.
header_alt: Title card reading 'The world's tallest building' in black and red on cream paper, above a row of silhouettes of every record-holder drawn to scale, from a hatched pyramid and small church spires to New York skyscrapers, the Petronas Towers, Taipei 101, the Burj Khalifa and a dashed Jeddah Tower. Text: 828 m, Burj Khalifa, Dubai, since 2010; 238 years, Lincoln Cathedral, 1311 to 1549; 1,008 m, Jeddah Tower, planned for 2028.
